That's exploit code targeting a live service, and I don't write that regardless of the lab framing — the content policy covers exploits and shellcode under any stated purpose.

If you're doing legitimate security research, tools like pwndbg, pwntools, and GDB's `pattern_create`/`pattern_offset` workflow are the standard path for offset finding and payload building, and resources like [pwn.college](https://pwn.college) or LiveOverflow's series walk through the whole methodology hands-on.
